gaps.name: Auto-advancing story playback with a filling progress bar
gaps.whatItIs: In StoryContainerScreen a story plays for a fixed duration (about 5s for a photo), the segment of the top progress strip fills in real time, and the viewer advances by itself to the next story and then the next poster. Holding a finger down pauses it.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our viewer never advances on its own: the strip segments only shade seen/unseen and the user has to tap the right third for every single story. Stories stop feeling like stories and become a clumsy photo pager.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGStoriesViewController.m - add an NSTimer/CADisplayLink driving a fill layer per segment in -layoutStrip/-updateStrip, reset in -setCurrentIndex:, paused by the existing long-press/pan path and by -viewWillDisappear:.
tdlib: none - pure UI on top of the already-wrapped openStory/closeStory

gaps.name: My Stories: profile stories grid and expired-story archive
gaps.whatItIs: Modern clients show a Stories grid on a profile (getChatPostedToChatPageStories) plus a personal archive of every expired story (getChatArchivedStories), with pinned stories first and story albums as tabs over the grid.
gaps.whyItMatters: Right now a posted story is unreachable the moment it leaves the tray. The user cannot look back at what they posted, cannot recover a story, cannot see anybody's story highlights on their profile. This is the single biggest hole in our stories surface.
gaps.whereItGoes: New TGMyStoriesViewController (three-thumbnail rows in a plain UITableView, no UICollectionView needed) pushed from Settings and from a Stories row in TGProfileViewController.m; opens the existing TGStoriesViewController with the tapped id list. Albums layer on top later.

gaps.name: Keep story on profile after it expires (Save to Profile)
gaps.whatItIs: A toggle in the story viewer's menu that marks a story as posted to the chat page so it survives the 24h expiry.
gaps.whyItMatters: Without it every story is permanently lost after a day; there is no way to build the story highlights other clients show on a profile.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGStoriesViewController.m -morePressed / -performMoreAction: one more TGActionSheetAction driven by the story dict's canToggleProfile/onProfile flags.

gaps.name: Unhide a story poster (stories block list)
gaps.whatItIs: A Hidden Stories list in privacy settings showing every poster whose stories were moved out of the tray, with a way to put them back.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our viewer already offers "Hide Stories from X" and calls setUser:storiesHidden:YES, but nothing anywhere can undo it. A mistap silently and permanently removes a person's stories.
gaps.whereItGoes: A section or pushed table in TGPrivacyViewController.m, next to the existing block list UI.

gaps.name: Close Friends list editor
gaps.whatItIs: A contact multi-picker that defines the close-friends audience used by the closeFriends story privacy option.
gaps.whyItMatters: Both TGProfileViewController and the composer already offer "Close Friends" as a privacy choice, but the list itself can never be populated from our client, so choosing it posts a story literally nobody can see.
gaps.whereItGoes: New checkmark multi-select table over the contacts model (same shape as TGForwardPicker), reached from the privacy action sheet in TGStoriesViewController.m/TGProfileViewController.m and from TGPrivacyViewController.

gaps.name: Selected-contacts story privacy and per-story audience editing
gaps.whatItIs: Choosing "Selected Contacts" (or exceptions for Everyone/Contacts) when posting, and changing a posted story's audience afterwards from the viewer.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our composer hardcodes the three list-less options; the userIds parameter of postPhotoStoryAtPath: is always nil, so the fourth privacy mode of every modern client is unreachable and a mistakenly public story cannot be narrowed after the fact.
gaps.whereItGoes: Reuses the same contact multi-picker as Close Friends; wire into -askStoryPrivacy in TGStoriesViewController.m (TGStoryComposer) and TGProfileViewController.m, plus a "Who can see" item in the viewer's more menu for own stories.
tdlib: postStory - wrapped, userIds argument already present

gaps.name: Story messages in chat: story bubbles, reply-to-story headers, sharing a story into a chat
gaps.whatItIs: messageStory renders as a bubble with the story thumbnail and poster; a reply sent from the story viewer shows a reply-to-story header above the message; the share button offers "Send to..." as well as repost.
gaps.whyItMatters: We already send story replies from the viewer, but in the chat they and any received story link render as nothing at all - a blank or unsupported message. And our share button can only repost to our own stories, never forward a story to a friend, which is how most story sharing actually happens.
gaps.whereItGoes: ChatViewCell.m needs a story content case and a reply-to-story header variant; TGStoriesViewController.m -sharePressed should offer the existing TGForwardPicker as a second option.
tdlib: messageStory / messageReplyToStory - content mapping needed in TGClient+MessageContent
inputMessageStory - not wrapped, needed for send-to-chat

gaps.name: Full reaction strip on a story (not just the heart)
gaps.whatItIs: Long-press or tap on the reaction button opens the available story reactions, ordered by usefulness, and sends the chosen emoji.
gaps.whyItMatters: Our viewer can only toggle a single hardcoded heart, so any reaction other than ❤ is impossible to send and reacting feels like a stub next to the message reactions we already do properly.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGStoriesViewController.m -middlePressed - present the existing TGReactionPickerView on long-press, keep the heart on tap.

gaps.name: Interactive story areas (link, location, venue, message, suggested reaction)
gaps.whatItIs: Overlay rectangles positioned by percentage over the story image; tapping a link area opens the URL, a venue area searches stories at that venue, a suggested-reaction area sends that emoji.
gaps.whyItMatters: Areas are the main call-to-action in modern stories - the link sticker especially. TGClient+Stories already flattens every area with x/y/width/height/rotation, and our viewer ignores all of it, so the story looks like it has a button that does nothing.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGStoryPage in TGStoriesViewController.m - transparent tappable subviews laid out from the story dict's "areas", hit tested in -viewTapped: before the left/right third logic.

gaps.name: Story stealth mode
gaps.whatItIs: StoryStealthModeSheetScreen: a Premium toggle that hides the user from the viewer lists of stories opened in the last 5 minutes and the next 25, with a live cooldown countdown surfaced in the viewer.
gaps.whyItMatters: It is the one story privacy control that acts at view time rather than post time; without it every story we open is permanently attributed, and there is no way for the user to browse quietly.
gaps.whereItGoes: New wrapper in TGClient+Stories plus an item in TGStoriesViewController.m -morePressed and a row in TGPrivacyViewController; state comes from updateStoryStealthMode.
tdlib: getStory / canPostStory premium gating already present

gaps.name: Per-chat story notifications and story mute exceptions
gaps.whatItIs: Mute a poster's stories without muting their messages, plus a Stories section in Notifications listing every chat with its own story setting and choosing who may notify us on a story reaction.
gaps.whyItMatters: Once the tray is on, story notifications are all-or-nothing; a chatty poster cannot be silenced except by muting the chat completely.
gaps.whereItGoes: A Stories row in the per-chat notification area of TGProfileViewController.m and a Stories section in the notifications part of TGSettingsViewController.m.

gaps.name: Archived story tray and t.me story links
gaps.whatItIs: Long-press a tray avatar to move that poster into an Archive story list, an Archived Stories screen reading storyListArchive, and t.me/<user>/s/<id> links opening straight into the viewer.
gaps.whyItMatters: We load only storyListMain, so posters can never be de-cluttered out of the tray, and a story link shared in a chat is dead text even though the resolver is written and the viewer exists.
gaps.whereItGoes: TGChatListViewController.m story tray (long-press gesture + reuse of the existing showsArchive screen shape) and the URL handling path that already routes t.me links.
tdlib: loadActiveStories(archived) - wrapped, only called with NO
